newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Most Estonia stocks drop as investors give up wait.
newsitem.headline: Most Estonia stocks drop as investors give up wait.

text.p: Local investors on Wednesday gave up waiting for bulls to appear on the Estonian market to start and the resultant selling mood shaped trade for the day, dealers said.
The Talse index lost 2.62 percent to close on 259.35 kroons with 46 million kroons of shares traded on the main list.
"Disgruntled local investors most likely gave up waiting for the market to move higher and decided to sell this morning," one dealer said.
"No one could have predicted this was going to happen this morning but it did test the floor for several stocks," he added.
Forekspank turned over 15.3 million kroons to be the most traded stock. The stock closed at 185.25, 4.25 kroons lower.
Hansapank turned over 14.7 million kroons to end down 4.20 kroons at 134.25 kroons.
"Hansapank fell to a low of 133 kroons and then found some stability at 134-135 kroons, so buyers were not prepared for the stock to go too far down," another dealer said.
The over-the-counter market saw 5.8 million kroons of shares change hands with Tallinna Kaubamaja the most active stock.
Tallinna Kaubamaja was also lower at 90.25, a fall of 1.95 kroons on trade of 2.3 million kroons.
"The free market shadowed the main list with most stocks ending lower," a dealer said.
